turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, okay? Today we will do subtraction. First sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Everyone write it in your notebook.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. The answer is twenty five. Write twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, thirty five also? I told na, you have to borrow. You have to borrow. Borrow from the tens, then subtract. Borrow, then subtract.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, twenty six is not correct. Okay, leave it, we don't have much time. Next sum.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Now do forty three minus eighteen. Quickly, everyone.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five. Forty three minus eighteen is twenty five. All of you say it, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Who got twenty five? Hands up. Hmm, only few hands. Everyone understood now, no? Thumbs up.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Ravi, again you did big minus small, I saw. How many times I have to tell? Don't do like that. Okay, sixty one minus thirty four, try at home.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold
